  SPECIAL MEETING

 CALL TO ORDER

 At 3:09 PM, Mayor Richardson called the meeting to order.

 ROLL CALL

 Councilmembers Present: Zendejas, Duggan, Kerr, Saro, Uranga, Thrash-Ntuk

 Councilmembers Absent: Allen, Supernaw, Ricks-Oddie

 Also present: Thomas Modica, City Manager, April Walker, Assistant City Manager, Tyler Bonanno-
 Curley, Deputy City Manager, Millicent Usoro, Deputy City Attorney, Karen Baldwin, Senior City Clerk
 Analyst, Yaelly Santana, City Clerk Specialist.

 Mayor Richardson presiding.

 STUDY SESSION

 1.  26-56387  Recommendation to receive and file a presentation and conduct a study session
  on the proposed Long Beach Framework for Accountability, Integrity, and
  Reporting (FAIR) Act, and provide City staff with further direction to incorporate
  within the proposed FAIR Act, as appropriate. (Citywide)

  A motion was made by Councilwoman Thrash-Ntuk, seconded by
  Councilwoman Kerr, to approve recommendation. The motion carried by the
  following vote:

  Yes:  6  Zendejas, Duggan, Kerr, Saro, Uranga, Thrash-Ntuk
  No:  0  None
  Recused: 0  None
  Absent: 3  Allen, Supernaw, Ricks-Oddie
